title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
original_title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter multimodal vision-language model, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. Deploy the NVFP4 or BF16 variant in a few steps, then run text, image,…
title_zh: 英伟达 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 已登陆亚马逊云
lead_zh: 参数规模为 120B 的英伟达多模态视觉语言模型现已可在亚马逊云上部署，并提供两种精度版本。
